searchText: 👍 Do you have example bytecode for an abstracted account yet? Besides the AA prelude we talked about earlier, we don't yet. We're planning to build a contract that will do `N` loops before `PAYGAS` first, to see what the load looks like, then we'll try to build some more useful examples.
